description: This file defines a debug logging observer class for frame activity monitoring within a pipeline, including filtering and detailed logging of frame data.

classes.name: FrameEndpoint
classes.description: Enumeration to specify whether filtering is based on source or destination endpoint.

classes.name: DebugLogObserver
classes.description: Observer class that logs detailed frame activity, with filtering options and customizable field exclusion.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DebugLogObserver with optional frame type filters and fields to exclude from logs.

methods.name: _format_value
methods.description: Formats a value for logging, handling various data types including strings, lists, bytes, and custom objects.

methods.name: _should_log_frame
methods.description: Determines whether a given frame should be logged based on configured filters.

methods.name: on_push_frame
methods.description: Handles the event of a frame being pushed into the pipeline, logging detailed information if filters permit.
